arabic text: AY YUSUF E SARWAR, HUM SHAKL E PAYAMBAR
english translation text: O Yusuf of Sarwar, O likeness of the Prophet—Akbar, Ali Akbar.

arabic text: YEH LASHA E AKBAR PE SARWAR NE KIYA NOHA\nKIS TARHA SE LEJAWU KHAIME ME TERA LASHA\nMARJAYE NA ZAINAB LAASHE SE LIPAT KAR
english translation text: Over Akbar's body, Sarwar recited this lament:\nhow can I carry your body back to the tents?\nZainab may die when she embraces your body.

arabic text: BACHPAN SE JAWANI TAK NAZON SE JISSE PALA\nZINDA NA RAHA HAYE ATHARA BARAS WALA\nNOORE DILE ZAINAB NOOR E DILLE MADAR
english translation text: From childhood to youth, he was raised with tenderness;\nalas, the eighteen-year-old did not remain alive.\nHe was the light of Zainab's heart and the light of his mother's heart.

arabic text: KAB KOI SAMAJH PAYE YEH GHAM TERA KAISA HAI\nBETE KE BICHARNE KO BAS BAAP SAMAJHTA HAI\nNA CHOR KE JAAWO PARDES ME DILBAR
english translation text: Who can understand what such grief truly means?\nOnly a father understands separation from a son.\nDo not leave me alone in this foreign land, my beloved.

arabic text: SEHRA WOH SAJA LETI ARMAAN YEH MA KA HAI\nJAATE HUWE MAQTAL ME USNE TUJHE DEKHA HAI\nTAKTI HAI TERA RASTAA HAYE MADARE MUZTAR
english translation text: His mother wished to adorn him with a wedding crown;\nas he went to the battlefield, she watched him depart.\nThe grieving mother continues to stare towards his path.

arabic text: ABBAS KE JAANE SE TOOTI HAI KAMAR PEHLE\nSADMA YEH TUMHARA AB HUM KAISE SAHE HAYE\nTUM BHI HO BICHARTE AB JAAN HAI LABON PER
english translation text: Abbas's departure had already broken my back;\nhow can I now endure the shock of losing you?\nYou too are leaving, while my life has reached my lips.

arabic text: AYA HAI MADINE SE KHAT FATEMA SUGHRA KA\nBECHAYN WATAN ME HAI BEEMAR BEHAN SUGHRA\nLIKHTI HAI WOH KHAT ME LAUT AAWO BARADAR
english translation text: A letter has arrived from Madina, written by Fatima Sughra;\nthe ailing sister is restless in her homeland.\nShe writes: return, my brother.

arabic text: SHABIR SAR E MAQTAL SALMAN TARAPTE HAI\nHAR EK QADAM PER WO GHIRTE HAI SAMBHALTE HAI\nSAMBHLA NAHI JATA LASHE KO UTHAKAR
english translation text: O "Salman", Shabbir writhes in the battlefield;\nat every step he falls and then steadies himself.\nHe cannot remain standing while lifting the body.
